<div class="movies-page">

  <section class="movies-opening">

    <div class="movies-kicker">
      AT THE MOVIES
    </div>

    <div class="movies-heading">
      Watching is only half of it.
    </div>

    <div class="movies-deck">
      I watch widely across languages, countries and periods, and I tend to
      remember films by writing them down.
    </div>

  </section>


  <section class="movies-ledger">

    <div class="movies-entry">

      <div class="movies-entry-number">
        01
      </div>

      <div class="movies-entry-label">
        WATCH
      </div>

      <div class="movies-entry-text">
        Cinema is one of the places where I am happily indiscriminate.
        Language, country and period are rarely filters; if something
        interests me, subtitles are hardly going to stop me.
      </div>

    </div>


    <div class="movies-entry">

      <div class="movies-entry-number">
        02
      </div>

      <div class="movies-entry-label">
        LOG
      </div>

      <div class="movies-entry-text">
        I log films on Letterboxd with unreasonable consistency. Some
        entries are critiques, some are notes on what stayed with me,
        and some record the mood or circumstances around the viewing.
      </div>

    </div>


    <div class="movies-entry movies-entry-last">

      <div class="movies-entry-number">
        03
      </div>

      <div class="movies-entry-label">
        REMEMBER
      </div>

      <div class="movies-entry-text movies-entry-emphasis">
        Over time, the diary has become less a record of what I watched
        and more a record of who I was when I watched it.
      </div>

    </div>

  </section>


  <section class="movies-afterword">

    <div class="movies-afterword-main">
      I like the thought that years from now, the log might still tell
      someone something about the person doing the watching.
    </div>

  </section>


  <div class="movies-footnote">
    Continuity errors in my own opinions are preserved for archival purposes.
  </div>

</div>
